integrity: The all-iteration result follows from the reciprocal Rayleigh-quotient step bound; the two-dimensional statement is proved from an exact two-step residual scaling; and the sharp three-dimensional obstruction follows by a continuous small-mode construction. The embedded exact-rational verifier checks only displayed identities and witnesses, not the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Positive diagonal Hessians in the coordinate basis in which nonnegativity is tested; zero initialization; exact line search; exact arithmetic. Nondiagonal Hessians, inexact line searches, projected methods, nonzero starts, and finite-precision sign robustness are not classified.
title: Condition two is the sharp dimension-free positivity frontier for exact-line-search steepest descent
